capabilities.assetBasis: Successful ERC-20 Transfer events; not portfolio balance deltas

accountEffects.scope: All bounded observed transfer participants and configured permission roles; separately measured balances and allowances are referenced without inferring missing state

affectedBalanceMeasurement.scope: Observed configured USDC/hUSDC/variable-debt Transfer participants and verified transferFrom owners/recipients; unknown, silent and native changes remain outside scope

balanceMeasurement.scope: Current-state Hyperlend USDC supply, withdrawal, variable-rate borrow and repay; involved user USDC, receipt-token and debt balances; configured query paths and mutation behavior validated before and after the call

currentCallEnvironment.scope: Unsigned zero-native-value contract calls from code-free senders; token queries use isolated complete poststate overrides, with header, nonce and mutation checks

historicalBalanceMeasurement.scope: Reconciled Hyperlend USDC operations plus bounded observed configured-token participants; original block and transaction position, separate token reads and isolated original-call validation

permissionObservations.scope: ERC20 approve, implementation-verified ERC-2612 permit and ERC20 transferFrom calls, and Approval events for configured USDC/hUSDC
permissionObservations.scopeLimit: Only verified USDC/hUSDC permission pairs observed in a successful execution; owner, transaction submitter, immediate caller and recipient remain distinct. Transfer amounts are not requested allowances.

historicalAllowanceMeasurement.scope: Configured USDC/hUSDC permission pairs at the original transaction position; unsupported state changes and inconsistent provider indexes are unavailable

limitations: Unknown protocols have partial coverage even when token events can be decoded.
HyperCore actions are not executed by the EVM tracing backend.
Receipt-token events can include accrued interest already reflected in token balances.
Token metadata is verified only for configured assets. Pricing is not provided.
Trace execution does not validate a real transaction signature or guarantee future inclusion.

capabilities.name: Ethereum
limitations: Explicit queried accounts only; other assets and economic effects may be omitted.
Synthetic BASEFEE-zero execution with no outer transaction signature or fee-settlement validation. Contract permit checks still execute.
Native balance measurements exclude outer transaction fees; observed value-flow candidates are not measured balance changes.
Historical block-end state is not the original transaction position.
Token labels and decimals are historical reference metadata, not verified again for the requested state.
Provider codeHash consistency is not independent state or source-code attestation.
Position queries use declared contract, user and market identities. Raw fields do not establish deployment identity, asset value or account health.
No security verdict or comparative detection score is produced.

sequenceExamples.title: Approve USDC, then supply to Aave V3
sequenceExamples.description: Constructed unsigned example at a historical block end. The approval feeds the following supply; this is not an original historical transaction pair.

reference.derivation: The supply keeps the first four ABI arguments from supplyWithPermit. A separate approval is prepended; its permit suffix is not reused.

limitations: Each call starts from the validated state left by the preceding successful call, at the same block time.
These are separate unsigned calls, not an atomic bundle or a guarantee of transaction inclusion.
A failed call stops later calls; a verified earlier prefix is not rolled back.
Outer signatures and transaction fees are not modeled. Contract permit checks still execute.
Per-call token and native queries are bounded and do not establish complete economic effects or a security verdict.

Only explicit query pairs are measured. Native ETH balance queries read the requested accounts without executing code or adding query fees. Automatic token discovery, complete native-effect discovery and sequences are not provided by this endpoint.
Proofs and runtime code are checked against the selected header, whose hash is recomputed. Consensus, finality and contract identity are not independently established.

The default unsigned profile uses zero gas price and BASEFEE without fee settlement. Explicit EIP-1559 and EIP-4844 profiles use the selected block fee context and caller caps; settlement is reported only for a complete validated execution. No profile validates an outer transaction signature. Contract signature checks still execute.

Optional gas selects the original transaction gas limit within 21,000–5,000,000; the selected fork also requires sufficient intrinsic gas and calldata floor. Each token or position CALL query retains a separate 1,000,000 gas limit; native balance reads execute no code and consume no query gas.

Explicit to:null deploys initcode with CREATE; internal CREATE and CREATE2 require a proven deployable target. Zero nonce and empty code permit creation even when authenticated old storage exists: creation clears that storage before initcode, preserves the balance and rolls the clear back on failure. This follows the pinned execution specification; retained synthetic comparisons document disagreement with pinned Geth and stock EthereumJS for storage-only targets. Shanghai SELFDESTRUCT removes every committed execution account at transaction end. Cancun through BPO2 deletes only contracts created in that invocation. Amsterdam clears a newly created contract’s code, nonce and storage while preserving its residual balance; preexisting contracts keep their account state. Creation collisions require authenticated nonce or code evidence.

Transaction-end EIP-161 cleanup removes touched empty accounts and their entire storage, including the retained RIPEMD160 touch exception. The default profile adds no fee-related coinbase touch. A validated retained overlay may rematerialize a deleted account while preserving its authenticated original storage-root reset provenance; disposable queries with retained net mutations still withhold measurements.

Optional fees require maxFeePerGas and maxPriorityFeePerGas as raw wei strings. The explicit EIP-4844 profile also requires maxFeePerBlobGas and nonempty versioned hashes; its actual blob charge is burned without refund or beneficiary tip. Measurement queries stay unpriced, receive no blob hashes, do not repeat fees and still do not support BLOBBASEFEE.

Sender code must initially be empty or an exact existing EIP-7702 delegation on the supported Prague-or-later forks, including Sepolia Amsterdam. Up to sixteen signed authorization tuples may install, replace or clear delegations before a call; their changes survive a later message failure. On Amsterdam, authorization or recipient preparation running out of gas rolls back authorization changes while retaining the outer nonce and applicable fees. Authorization lists cannot accompany deployment or blob context. Other coded senders remain unsupported. Default blob calls use zero blob base fee. Explicit priced calls derive BLOBBASEFEE from the verified current header and pinned fork parameters; parent excess evolution, sidecars and inclusion remain unverified.

On supported Cancun-or-later forks, executed calls to the 0x0a point-evaluation precompile check EIP-4844 single-point KZG proofs. This does not validate blob sidecars, whole-blob validity or inclusion, and supplying blob hashes alone performs no point-evaluation check.

BLS12-381 operations use the Prague-or-later rules and P-256 signature verification uses Osaka-or-later rules. Unexpected cryptographic runtime failures withhold execution rather than becoming an invalid signature or catchable EVM failure. Before activation, these addresses keep ordinary account behavior.
In-range BLOCKHASH follows authenticated parent headers within the shared read and time budgets; missing ancestry is unavailable.

Supported networks are Ethereum mainnet and Sepolia. The selected endpoint must report the requested chain ID; header hashes and state proofs do not independently prove network membership. Pinned schedules support Shanghai through BPO2 on mainnet and Shanghai through Amsterdam on Sepolia, within fixed execution and state budgets. Sepolia ETH is test currency.
Process separation and a V8 heap limit are not an OS network/filesystem sandbox or a hard total-RSS limit.
No security verdict, complete economic-effect coverage or accuracy percentage is established.

Two to four unsigned calls share one sender, selected header, proof collector and cumulative local state. They are ordered and non-atomic. Every original is attempted before disposable query observations begin.

A completed revert or EVM failure stops later originals while preserving earlier steps and the failed invocation’s retained nonce, authorization and applicable fee effects. An unavailable invocation must restore its starting overlay.

One shared list of explicit token, position or native-account queries is measured around each completed original. Query state never feeds an original or another query. Missing measurements remain unknown; automatic discovery and complete economic-effect coverage are not established.

Each original may explicitly select a supported priced profile. Default originals and all CALL queries use zero gas price and BASEFEE without fee settlement. No outer transaction signature, transaction inclusion or original block position is validated.

Proofs and runtime code are checked against the selected hash-bound header and its final full-header confirmation. Chain selection comes from the configured endpoint’s chain ID; consensus, finality and contract identity are not independently established.

The fixed time, proof, byte, execution, state-read and output budgets are shared across the sequence. Per-call gas and depth limits remain invocation limits. Process separation and a V8 heap bound are not an OS sandbox or hard total-RSS cap.

Existing trusted-network fork, authorization, creation, lifecycle and cryptographic-precompile boundaries still apply. No security verdict, representative accuracy percentage or complete-effects claim is established.
